error.settings_conflict: Settings were changed in another window. Check the latest values and save again.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
error.setup_code: The setup code does not match. Check the control/setup-code file in the server data folder.
error.setup_password: The password must be 12–1,024 bytes, and the server must be able to save the settings.
error.password_mismatch: Enter the same password in both fields.
error.sessions_unavailable_tokens: Could not load session information. Token status is shown from registration history only.
error.project_create: Could not add the project. Check the name format and whether it already exists.
error.project_save: Could not save the project settings.
error.members_save: Could not save member roles. Check the username and keep the last enabled owner.
error.token_form_expired: The issue form expired or was already used. Check the details and issue again.
error.token_issue: Could not issue the project token. Check token authentication, your permission to issue tokens and the display name format.
error.user_create: Could not add the user. Check the username for duplicates or format, and the password length.
error.new_password_mismatch: The new password and its confirmation do not match.
error.user_save: Could not change the user. The fixed admin and the last enabled owner must stay.
notice.token_issued: Token issued. Copy the value below and keep it safe.
error.token_scope_upgrade: Restricted and automatic-registration tokens are turned off in instance settings. Ask an administrator. Restricted permissions need clients 0.15 or later and a completed compatibility check. Issue a token with full permissions for now.
error.token_scope_invalid: Check the token permissions and automatic registration settings. session:register is required; the automatic registration limit is 0 (unlimited) or 1–100000, and the lifetime is 0 (no expiry) or 1–36500 days.
error.token_cap: The project reached its limit of 256 active tokens. Revoke unused tokens or disconnect old sessions, then issue or approve again.
error.project_data_unavailable: This project's stored data cannot be read. An administrator must restore it from a backup.
